definitions.explanation: The state of being thoroughly wet, typically from rain or water. Used as a noun or as a na-adjective with の.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧びしょ{濡|ぬ}れになった。
examples.english: I got soaking wet from the rain.

examples.japanese: びしょ{濡|ぬ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着替|きが}えた→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧。
examples.english: I changed out of my soaking wet clothes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧びしょ{濡|ぬ}れだった。
examples.english: I forgot my umbrella on the way home, so by the time I got home I was drenched.

notes:
Describes being completely soaked with water, typically from rain. Can function as a noun or modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

FORMS:
びしょ is an intensifying prefix meaning "thoroughly" or "completely." Combined with {濡|ぬ}れ (wetness, from the verb ⟦{濡|ぬ}れる→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- びしょ{濡|ぬ}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get soaking wet
- びしょ{濡|ぬ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: soaking wet clothes
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧びしょ{濡|ぬ}れ: drenched from rain
- びしょ{濡|ぬ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま: while still soaking wet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ずぶ{濡|ぬ}れ→ずぶ濡れ：06186_zubunure⟧: drenched (similar meaning, sometimes implies even more thorough soaking)
- ⟦{濡|ぬ}れる→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧: to get wet (the base verb; びしょ{濡|ぬ}れ is the extreme degree)

USAGE:
Very common in everyday conversation, especially when talking about being caught in rain without an umbrella.
